sender: Klinikum Musterstadt, Department of Internal Medicine
summary: You were in hospital from 1 to 8 October 2026. You had an infection of the kidney. It got better with antibiotics. You have a new medicine for your blood pressure. Do not take Metformin for now. See your family doctor on 15 October 2026.
action_steps: Take your medicines as shown in your daily plan.
Take the antibiotic Cefuroxim until 12 October 2026. Then it is finished.
Do not take Metformin until your doctor has checked your kidneys.
Drink at least 2 litres every day.
Go to your family doctor on 15 October 2026.
Get help at once if you get a high fever, strong pain in your side, or feel confused.

key_items.label: Kidney infection (Pyelonephritis)
key_items.explanation: You had an infection of your right kidney. It caused fever and pain in your side.

key_items.label: High blood pressure (Hypertonie)
key_items.explanation: Your blood pressure is too high. Medicines help to keep it normal.

key_items.label: Diabetes type 2 (Diabetes mellitus)
key_items.explanation: Your blood sugar is too high. This is a long-term illness.

key_items.label: Check-up at your family doctor
key_items.explanation: Your doctor will check your kidneys and your blood sugar.

key_items.label: Get help at once if…
key_items.explanation: If you get a fever over 38.5 degrees, strong pain in your side, or feel confused: see your doctor at once, or go to the emergency department.
key_items.source_quote: Bei Fieber über 38,5 °C, starken Flankenschmerzen oder Verwirrtheit stellen Sie sich bitte sofort beim Hausarzt oder in der Notaufnahme vor.

key_items.label: Drink enough
key_items.explanation: Drink at least 2 litres of water or tea every day. This helps your kidneys.
key_items.source_quote: Bitte trinken Sie mindestens 2 Liter pro Tag.

key_items.label: Metformin: wait for your doctor
key_items.explanation: Start Metformin again only when your doctor says so, after a kidney test.
key_items.source_quote: Metformin bitte erst nach Kontrolle der Nierenwerte wieder ansetzen.

key_items.label: Hospital ward 4B
key_items.explanation: Call this number if you have questions about your hospital stay.

medications.name: Ramipril
medications.instructions: Take one tablet in the morning and one in the evening.

medications.name: Amlodipin
medications.purpose: New medicine for your blood pressure.
medications.instructions: Take one tablet in the morning.

medications.name: Cefuroxim
medications.instructions: Take one tablet in the morning and one in the evening, until 12 October 2026.

medications.name: Metformin
medications.instructions: Do not take it for now. Your doctor will tell you when to start again.

Hospital stay: 1 October 2026 to 8 October 2026

blocks.original:

Akute Pyelonephritis rechts (N10)
Arterielle Hypertonie (I10.90)
Diabetes mellitus Typ 2 (E11.90)
blocks.translation:
Diagnoses:
Acute kidney infection, right side (N10)
High blood pressure (I10.90)
Type 2 diabetes (E11.90)

blocks.original: Verlauf: Die Patientin wurde mit Fieber und Flankenschmerzen aufgenommen. Unter intravenöser Antibiose besserte sich der Zustand rasch. Kreatinin bei Entlassung 1,4 mg/dl.
blocks.translation: Course: The patient was admitted with fever and pain in the side. With intravenous antibiotics her condition improved quickly. Creatinine at discharge 1.4 mg/dl.

blocks.original:
Medikation bei Entlassung:
Ramipril 5 mg 1-0-1-0 (unverändert)
Amlodipin 5 mg 1-0-0-0 (neu)
Cefuroxim 500 mg 1-0-1-0 bis einschließlich 12.10.2026 (neu)
Metformin 1000 mg wurde pausiert.
blocks.translation:
Medication at discharge:
Ramipril 5 mg 1-0-1-0 (unchanged)
Amlodipine 5 mg 1-0-0-0 (new)
Cefuroxime 500 mg 1-0-1-0 up to and including 12 October 2026 (new)
Metformin 1000 mg has been paused.

blocks.original: Procedere: Bitte trinken Sie mindestens 2 Liter pro Tag. Metformin bitte erst nach Kontrolle der Nierenwerte wieder ansetzen. Wiedervorstellung beim Hausarzt am 15.10.2026 zur Kontrolle von Kreatinin und Blutzucker.
blocks.translation: Next steps: Please drink at least 2 litres per day. Restart Metformin only after the kidney values have been checked. Follow-up with the family doctor on 15 October 2026 to check creatinine and blood sugar.

blocks.original: Bei Fieber über 38,5 °C, starken Flankenschmerzen oder Verwirrtheit stellen Sie sich bitte sofort beim Hausarzt oder in der Notaufnahme vor.
blocks.translation: If you have a fever above 38.5 °C, strong pain in your side or confusion, see your family doctor or go to the emergency department immediately.
